subject: Roadmap & decision canvas — MAP draft and milestone ask
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura@lumahealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: next steps & MAP template request

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Michael and I walked away excited about the latency/cost profile you showed for inference at scale.

We’d like to formalize a short MAP so we can align on milestones and what success looks like over the next 60 days. Can you share a starting MAP template (doc or slides) and a suggested timeline we can review internally?

Quick context: our key stakeholders are product (me), infra (Michael), and security (Victor, cc’d later once we have a draft). We’re targeting an internal decision on pilot by May 31.

Appreciate any template and a short list of milestones you recommend.

—Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Product, Luma Health
laura@lumahealth.com
(415) 555-0194
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@lumahealth.com>, Michael Torres <michael.t@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2024 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: next steps & MAP template request

Hi Laura — great to meet you both and glad the demo landed.

I’ve attached a starter MAP (MAP-template-v1.gdoc) and a short checklist for a 60-day pilot. The doc is intentionally lightweight: 4 milestone buckets (Kickoff, Tech Validation, Pilot Run, Acceptance) with suggested owners and a proposed close timeline.

A couple questions to help us tailor:
- What is your minimum viable acceptance criteria for the pilot (latency p95, throughput, cost target, or qualitative outcomes)?
- Who will own production readiness decisions on your side (name and email for the RACI)?
- Any hard compliance requirements (data residency, retention) we should call out up front?

Proposed quick milestones (high level):
1) Week 0: Kickoff + access (Redwood test account, API keys, sample data) — Owner: Luma/Laura
2) Week 1–2: Integration + smoke tests (small test corpus) — Owner: Luma/Michael 
3) Week 3–4: Scale test + performance tuning (batching / quantization suggestions) — Owner: Redwood/Jasmine
4) Week 5–8: Pilot run + acceptance gating (acceptance matrix attached) — Owner: Joint

I’ll ask Jasmine to pull a version with a technical checklist (KV cache, token budgets, example prompts) and Marissa to add a customer success checkpoint for rollout readiness.

Link to the live doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-MAP-template-v1 (edit access for your team).

If May 31 is your decision date, I recommend we schedule two short alignment calls: one next week to confirm owners and a 30-minute checkpoint in week 3. Do either of these work?

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Attachments: MAP-template-v1.gdoc
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2024 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Follow-up: next steps & MAP template request

Tessa —

Thanks for sharing. Quick notes on the template before we send to Luma:
- Add a technical checkpoint at end of Week 2 for 'KV cache behavior and warm starts' — we’ve seen that be a gating issue for healthcare NLP workloads.
- Call out a minimal security evidence list they should expect (SOC 2 summary, data retention options, KMS integration checklist). They’ll loop in Victor from security later but worth surfacing early.
- Suggest adding a short prompt-sample section so their PMs can validate quality without heavy engineering work.

I’ve started a copy and will drop comments in the doc. Marissa — can you also add the CS readiness gate items (training ops, support SLA expectations)?

—Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Technical Account Lead, Redwood
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@lumahealth.com>, Michael Torres <michael.t@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2024 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft MAP & proposed 60-day milestones (updated)

Hi Laura / Michael —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We combined Jasmine and Marissa’s feedback and uploaded an updated MAP + a short acceptance matrix (attached). Summary below and link to live doc with comments: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-MAP-template-v1

Summary milestones (proposed dates — editable):
- Week 0 (Apr 15): Kickoff + access provisioned — owners: Laura (Luma), Tessa (Redwood)
- Week 1–2 (Apr 15–Apr 28): Integration + smoke tests + prompt sample validation — owners: Michael (Luma), Jasmine (Redwood)
- Week 3 (Apr 29–May 5): Technical checkpoint (KV cache, batching, token budgets) — owner: Jasmine
- Week 4–6 (May 6–May 20): Performance tuning & pilot run (run on subset of production queries) — owners: Joint
- Week 7–8 (May 21–May 31): Acceptance and exec review — acceptance matrix attached; decision target: May 31

Open asks for you before our alignment call:
1) Confirm primary owners (PM and Infra) and an alternate contact for on-call items.
2) Confirm the acceptance criteria line items you care most about (we included latency p95, throughput baseline, and a qualitative QA sample pass).
3) Please grant edit access to Victor (security) or I can export a redacted evidence pack to share.

Next steps: Can we lock a 30-minute alignment call next Tue or Wed (Apr 16–17)? I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm a preferred slot.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Luma_acceptance_matrix.xlsx
